load_qwen_tokenizer: load a Qwen tokenizer from a model path with QwenTokenizerConfig and custom EOS token settings
create_QwenTokenizer_encoder: create a token encoder from QwenTokenizer with modes like prompt, prompt_response, or as_is
create_QwenTokenizer_decoder: create a token decoder from QwenTokenizer with optional skip_special_tokens flag
configure_QwenTokenizerConfig: configure QwenTokenizerConfig dataclass with use_im_end boolean to control EOS token selection
get_QwenTokenizer_vocab_info: get vocabulary info from QwenTokenizer using the vocab_info property to access model token details
